The '''EX-49 Mining Droid''' was a [[Mining droid/Legends|mining droid]] model in use during the [[Galactic War]]. Several EX-49 Mining Droids were usied to mine [[Exonium/Legends|Exonium]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
EX-49 Mining Droids appear in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, added to the game with Update 3.0.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
